C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-2-7AD2A006.IntentSummary:
This T0 plan converts the approved `C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-2-7AD2A006` spec into two sequential tasks. **T-001 — the mechanism:** the three `package.json` scripts carry `--timeout=0`; the **82** per-test pins across six test files are removed; the four suite-running workflow jobs carry `timeout-minutes: 30`; the pin guard and the workflow guard land in `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts`; the taught `ngrace-spec` sentence is rewritten in both trees, both `TAUGHT_RULES` token tables change from `explicit generous timeout` to `only ceiling`; `README.md:382` becomes `bun run test`; and the skill-text footprint pin **and** the README cell are set to the footprint **measured after the rewrite** (`skillTextLines().total` / `.totalBytes` at that tree state), never to this plan's projected figures. **T-002 — the payment:** flush `F266` and `F267` through the shipped parser, `xmlEscape` and canonical serializer, add one index `Entry` each, mint the chartered row `C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-2-7AD2A006` with `Pays F266 F267`, run `--rewrite-roots`, then land the flush-invariant and row walks and drive the faithful post-close applied-archive copy.
**The footprint is in the spec's scope now, not forced by discovery.** The successor spec's write-scope Constraint names `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` (the skill-footprint pins the taught-sentence rewrite forces) and the README cell, so the plan's `ObservedWriteScope` inherits both. That file is a `.test.ts`, so `isModuleOwnableWritePath` is false and `change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope` cannot fire; `src/test-support/token-accounting.ts` (module-ownable under `M-TEST-SUPPORT`) is **not** written (F267).
**The two-entry flush projection is measured, not inherited.** Driven through the shipped serializer on a `405a748` copy, flushing `F266` and `F267` and `--rewrite-roots` leaves findings `7396 / 319 / 7715`, index `267 / 29 / 296`, registry `13 / 13 / 26`, rulings `1715 / 168 / 1883`; the close's `--retire` moves 3 and leaves findings `7343 / 291 / 7634`, index `265 / 31 / 296`, registry `12 / 14 / 26`. No criterion pins a root number, only `base == newlineCount` and `base + headroom = ceiling`. (The spec's `Assumptions` keep the draft-sentence footprint figures and the predecessor's one-entry roots as dated projections.)
**What this T0 plan drops from the T2 house form, and why each drop is safe.** No teaching task (the teaching moves inside T-001), no instruments task, no footprint task (T-001 carries the one footprint pin), no separate third task (the closing copy drive has no recordable red and shares T-002's final on-disk state). `DurableScope` is the spec's single `AffectedAreas` anchor, `M-SKILLS`, covered by `V-M-SKILLS` from the shipped verification document. The plan's baseline needles assert only what the bundle leaves unchanged; the pins, the old token, the old byte total and the absent `f266`/`f267` are the bundle's flips and live in T-001/T-002 criteria, never in `BaselineAssertions`. The red-first signature keys sit inside the shipped budgets (`src/grace-cursor.ts`: `FIX_SIGNATURE_REPEAT_BUDGET` = 2, `FIX_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE_BUDGET` = 4): T-001 records `pin-guard`, `ceiling-guard` and `footprint-pin` (one fail each); T-002 records `flush-invariant` and `record-row` (one fail each) plus the pass-only `post-close-drive` cycle, which counts toward neither budget — at most three distinct failing signatures in one task's window (inside `FIX_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE_BUDGET` = 4), none repeated (inside `FIX_SIGNATURE_REPEAT_BUDGET` = 2). Every criterion in the authorizing spec is close-bound (it carries `CloseEvidence`), so no task lists `<Satisfies>`; a `Satisfies` of a close-bound `AC-*` is the shipped `change.close-evidence-and-satisfied` error. The last task ends at the live row, `--rewrite-roots` applied and the record validating clean; the close (`terminal`, `fold`, `--assertions final --run-commands`, a second terminal, `fold`, `review`, `gate verdict`, `gate apply`, `gate archive`, `apply`, the production `--retire`) is the authority's.
**Lineage — the predecessor's blocker and its repair.** This plan is re-homed from the archived `C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-1-4985C820` draft, whose drive found the predecessor spec's `AC-NO-OTHER-SRC` unsatisfiable: its exclude list omitted the forced footprint file `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts`, so the command exited 1 naming exactly that file and `gate verdict --outcome pass` refused (F267). Under `D27` the authority superseded the predecessor; the successor spec names the footprint in its write-scope `Constraint` and in `AC-NO-OTHER-SRC`'s excludes, so no criterion is now unsatisfiable. The blocker paragraph that stood here is history, recorded in F267.
